title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Brandi Harden is currently the Managing Partner at Harden & Pinckney, PLLC, a boutique law firm located in downtown Washington, D.C. Harden & Pinckney, PLLC specializes in criminal defense and complex civil litigation, child custody, divorce, and family law.
